title: Great Stones at Tahpanhes
reflectionText: The proud men said to Jeremiah, “You speak falsely.” Johanan and the captains took the remnant of Judah, with Jeremiah and Baruch, into Egypt, for they did not obey Yahweh’s voice. In Tahpanhes, Yahweh’s word came to Jeremiah. When others will not listen, where do you still listen for God’s word?
editorialNotes: Packet 035 initial writer output. Short-only owner plan. The retelling remains within Jeremiah 43:1-13. It joins verses 1-3 into one sentence and verses 5-6 into one sentence (the WEB dash at the end of verse 5 is rendered as a colon). Yahweh’s word in verses 9-13 is one quotation, with the message for the men of Judah as an inner quotation broken into a paragraph at verse 12. The passage records the command to hide the stones but not its performance, and the retelling does not narrate it. It keeps WEB mortar/“brick work”/Nebuchadnezzar/“Yahweh of Armies”/pillars and KJV clay/brickkiln/Nebuchadrezzar/“Lord of hosts”/images in their own lanes, and ends with the burning of the houses of the gods of Egypt in verse 13.
